races.display_title: Sebden Steel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: An interesting opener. A big-field bumper win at the spring festival here marks down DELAMOTTE as one who can do well over hurdles for his top stable. Kingstonian rates an obvious danger after 2 good placed efforts since switched to hurdles. Brady Hartsfield and Bacharach should have more to offer on the back of promising hurdle debuts. Point recruit Menethil is the mount of Jack Kennedy from the Gordon Elliott quintet. DELAMOTTE (FR) KINGSTONIAN BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)

races.display_title: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
races.verdict: After only the 2 outings over hurdles, MIGHTY PARK looks an exciting prospect for chasing and starts off in a race in which Willie Mullins tends to introduce one of his better novices, Gaelic Warrior landing the prize in 2023. races.display_title: Vietti Barolo Hurst Park Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: VANDERPOEL took his form up to a smart level when making a successful return over C&D 3 weeks ago and, with further improvement likely in his second season over fences, he is fancied to follow up. Shakeyatailfeather is feared most with conditions promising to suit, while Calico also gives Dan Skelton a strong hand. VANDERPOEL (IRE) SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE) CALICO (GER)

races.verdict: GREY DAWNING can emulate Kauto Star, Cue Card, Bristol de Mai and Royale Pagaille and become the fifth back-to-back winner of this race. races.display_title: Prancing To The Pilsner Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NORTH OF RICHMOND put a disappointing handicap debut behind him when scoring at Newcastle on his reappearance and it's reasonable to assume he could have further improvement in the pipeline given his lightly-raced profile, so a 2 lb higher mark looks well within his compass. Virtual Rock is thriving for his current yard and shouldn't be inconvenienced by the return to 2m given how he goes through his races, with Caelan completing the shortlist. NORTH OF RICHMOND (IRE) VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE) CAELAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: TAN RAPIDO won at this course in July and has returned from a break with solid efforts at Wolverhampton, including when shaping better than the bare result latest. Hucklesbrook looks well handicapped now, while Kiniro returns to this C&D, where he's twice a winner, and is worth another chance after his stalls mishap last time. TAN RAPIDO HUCKLESBROOK KINIRO

races.verdict: FUSEBOARD won back-to-back races in the summer, the second over C&D in August in what looks strong form, and can complete a hat-trick on return from a 93-day break. races.verdict: OXFORD CIRCUS is really starting to find his feet for this yard and looks up to completing a hat-trick.
